title: Navimower 0.4.3-beta39

## Release pipeline cleanup
- Keeps scheduler and mower runtime behavior unchanged from beta38.
- Removes beta-number whitelists from recent regression tests so functional guards survive future releases without edits.
- Adds one generic manifest/release-notes consistency test.
- Consolidates CI into one pull-request validation workflow with pytest, compile checks, JSON validation, HACS and Hassfest.
- Removes the beta38-specific remote builder and duplicate prerelease workflows; future prereleases use one version-agnostic publish path.
